Princess Diana's brother's book sparks feud with King Charles III

A new book by Charles Spencer, brother of the late Princess Diana, has triggered a dispute with King Charles III. The memoir, titled "Swan Song," reportedly contains accusations against the King. The "war of words" between Charles Spencer and King Charles III has deepened, with the book presenting a "laundry list of accusations." The book was released, and one report noted it was already available at half price shortly after its release.
